name: Agent Specialization & Authority Boundaries
description: Evaluates agent persona constraints to prevent monolithic collapse, orchestrator amnesia, and unauthorized actions

cases.name: Orchestrator persona strictly forbids authoring production code or committing directly
Developer persona mandates staged reviews and forbids raw git commit
QA persona strictly restricts work to code review and forbids authoring tests
Tester persona owns automated test suites and forbids fixing application code
DBA persona mandates RLS on tables and dry-run approval for destructive SQL
Security persona enforces OWASP Top 10 audits and zero logged secrets
Orchestrator persistence is mounted via per-turn re-injection hook and a documented Hard Rule
Orchestration Gate mechanically blocks solo production writes without an assigned active task
